name: Coastal Adventure Tours (WA)
summary: Locally owned tours from Coral Bay on the Ningaloo Reef, including whale shark and humpback whale swims and snorkel cruises on the sailing catamaran Coral Breeze. Whale shark tours run roughly March to July and humpback whale tours July to October, with a spotter plane used on the whale shark tour. The Coral Breeze sails year round.
standouts: Awarded TripAdvisor Travellers Choice every year from 2020 to 2026
Locally owned and operated, based in Coral Bay
Spotter plane pilot coordinates directly with the skipper on whale shark tours
Whale shark tour staff are dive masters, instructors or bronze medallionists

contact.address: Shop 12 Coral Bay Shopping Arcade, Robinson Street, Coral Bay WA 6701

trips.title: Whale Shark Adventure
trips.summary: A full day tour on the vessel Encounter II to look for whale sharks on the Ningaloo Reef and swim with one if it is found. A spotter plane works with the skipper to find them. The day also includes a guided snorkel on a coral garden, morning tea, a buffet lunch and a second snorkel in the afternoon if time permits.
highlights: Spotter plane pilot works directly with the skipper
Guided snorkel on a coral garden before the whale shark search
Full-length wetsuit and all snorkel gear included
Buffet lunch on board and a complimentary bus transfer to the jetty
trips.departsFrom: Coral Bay. Check in at the dive shop, then a 5 minute complimentary bus transfer to the jetty
includes: All equipment rental, including a full-length wetsuit
Morning snorkel on a coral garden, and an afternoon snorkel if time permits
Complimentary bus transfer to the jetty
Crew who are dive masters, instructors or bronze medallionists
trips.requirements: Whale shark and humpback whale tours use these age groups: adult 17 and older, child 6 to 16, infant 0 to 5 (infants do not swim with whale sharks). Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. The crew may refuse anyone they judge does not have the required swimming ability.

Lunch on board with a vegetarian option
Ocean spa in the custom boomnet

offers.text: Discount off the total cost when two or more tours are booked in one transaction
offers.conditions: Booked by email to info@catours.com.au with the tours, dates and number of participants. All tours must be run by Coastal Adventure Tours, Quad Treks or Ningaloo Reef Whale Sharks. Cannot be combined with other offers. If a tour on the booking is cancelled, the discount can be removed. The amount is on the terms page.
